texts.biography: A humble woodcutter blessed with extraordinary strength and courage, Thạch Sanh faced fearsome monsters and supernatural enemies without hesitation. Armed with his mighty axe and unshakable determination, he became a legendary hero whose strength and endurance carried him through the most dangerous battles.
texts.name: Thach Sanh

specialty.name: Stone Hunters
specialty.description: Increases the Speed of any Stone Hunters or Stone Slingers by 1 and their Attack and Defense skills by 5% for every level (rounded up).
